title: Construct 3.4km Integrated Covered Drainage & Sewerage Pipeline Network
problem_justification: Aggregated evidence from 847 citizen voice requests across Wards 14 & 15 indicates a critical failure of informal drainage lines. Fused with Census data (52% poverty rate, high child population) and PM Gati Shakti GIS layers (zero stormwater drains within a 3.2km radius), current municipal spending of ₹0 creates a severe public health hazard (dengue, cholera).
scope_of_work: Installation of 3.4 km high-density RCC underground sewerage and stormwater trunk pipeline
Construction of 18 junction inspection chambers with automated debris traps
1.8 km road resurfacing and asphalt sealing following trench excavation
Integration with South Indore Main Sewerage Treatment Plant (STP)

impact_metrics.disease_reduction: 65% estimated drop in waterborne diseases within 12 months
impact_metrics.flood_prevention: Prevents annual monsoon inundation for 8,700 households
impact_metrics.economic_savings: ₹1.4 Crores saved annually in individual healthcare and property repair costs

title: Super Corridor Expressway Expansion & BRTS Integration
funding_scheme: PM Gati Shakti / Smart Cities Mission
problem_justification: Traffic volume on the existing Super Corridor has exceeded capacity by 45%, leading to acute bottlenecks during peak hours. High accident rates and delayed transit times negatively impact IT hub productivity and airport connectivity.
scope_of_work: Widening of 6.2 km arterial road from 4 to 6 lanes
Construction of 2 grade-separated flyovers
Dedicated BRT lane integration and pedestrian pathways
Installation of smart traffic management and AI surveillance systems

impact_metrics.economic_growth: Enhances connectivity for 5 major IT parks

title: Narmada Water Supply Phase-IV Capacity Augmentation
problem_justification: Rapid urban expansion has led to a 120 MLD deficit in potable water supply, forcing reliance on over-extracted groundwater in peripheral wards. Pipeline leakages currently account for 25% non-revenue water.
scope_of_work: Laying of 45 km of primary and secondary transmission mains
Upgrading 3 key pumping stations with energy-efficient motors
Construction of 5 new overhead reservoirs (OHTs)
Implementation of SCADA for leak detection and flow monitoring

impact_metrics.water_availability: Ensures 24x7 pressurized water supply to 1.2 lakh households

title: City-Wide Solar Grid & Smart Streetlighting Upgrade
responsible_ministry: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
funding_scheme: Smart Cities Mission / National Solar Mission
problem_justification: High energy bills for street lighting place a severe strain on the municipal budget, while 18% of streetlights are currently dysfunctional. Poor lighting in several wards correlates with increased petty crime rates at night.
scope_of_work: Retrofitting 45,000 existing streetlights with smart LED fixtures
Installation of 2 MW rooftop solar panels on 25 municipal buildings
Integration with a Centralized Control and Monitoring System (CCMS)
Deployment of 500 solar-powered independent lighting poles in off-grid parks

impact_metrics.energy_savings: ₹5.2 Crores annual reduction in electricity bills
impact_metrics.carbon_footprint: Offsets 15,000 metric tons of CO2 annually
impact_metrics.public_safety: Enhances nighttime visibility and reduces petty crimes by 20%

title: Integrated Solid Waste Management & Bio-CNG Plant
problem_justification: With daily waste generation reaching 1,200 metric tons, existing processing facilities are operating at 110% capacity. An advanced Bio-CNG plant is required to sustain Indore's #1 cleanest city ranking and manage future organic waste efficiently.
scope_of_work: Construction of a 500 TPD Bio-CNG processing unit
Upgrading material recovery facilities (MRF) with AI-sorting robotic arms
Procurement of 120 CNG-powered secondary waste collection vehicles
Establishment of a localized green hydrogen pilot extractor

impact_metrics.waste_processing: Increases daily processing capacity by 500 tons
impact_metrics.fuel_generation: Produces 17,000 kg of Bio-CNG daily for city buses
impact_metrics.landfill_diversion: Achieves 100% zero-landfill status for organic waste

title: Indore Metro Rail Phase 1B Extension
problem_justification: The Eastern corridor of Indore faces massive congestion, with travel speeds dropping to 12 km/h during peak hours. Current public transit covers less than 30% of this high-density residential and commercial zone.
scope_of_work: Construction of 8.5 km elevated metro viaduct
Development of 7 new elevated metro stations with multi-modal integration
Procurement of 3 new rolling stock trains (3-car configuration)
Land acquisition and utility shifting along the corridor

impact_metrics.ridership: Expected daily ridership of 1.2 lakh passengers
impact_metrics.congestion_relief: Removes approximately 40,000 private vehicles from the road daily
impact_metrics.travel_time: Reduces end-to-end travel time from 45 mins to 16 mins
